title: Spicy Korean Rhubarb Jorim
description: A sweet and spicy Korean-inspired dish made with rhubarb and korean chili paste. This recipe is a twist on the traditional Korean side dish.
instructions: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the rhubarb and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
5. Pour the sauce over the rhubarb and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rhubarb is tender.
6. Stir in the sesame seeds and salt.
7. Serve the rhubarb hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
